references.text: The preceding context where Moses commands the arming of men for war against the Midianites, a thousand from each tribe
Describes men who are twenty years old and older, all who can go out to war in Israel, using the same expression for military service
The counting of all who can go out to war in Israel, from twenty years old and upward
Moses appointed leaders over thousands, reflecting the military organization by thousands
About forty thousand armed for war crossed over before the Lord's presence to battle, a similar military mobilization
God reduced Gideon's army, showing that God often uses a specific number of warriors to achieve victory
